justification: Inspected core/src/main/java/org/adoptopenjdk/jitwatch/model/assembly/arm/ARMShifter.java, ARMRegisterType.java, ARMDirective.java, ARMExtend.java, MnemonicEntry.java, and AssemblyParserARM.java. The package has 6 classes; 5 are self-contained enums/POJOs, and only AssemblyParserARM has cross-package dependencies, pointing to org.adoptopenjdk.jitwatch.model.assembly and org.adoptopenjdk.jitwatch.core. Those targets are broader, widely reused packages (e.g., AbstractAssemblyParser.java, AssemblyUtil.java, AssemblyReference.java, IMetaMember.java, Compilation.java, AbstractMetaMember.java, HotSpotLogParser.java, OSUtil.java, DisassemblyUtil.java), while the ARM package itself is only imported by three classes in org.adoptopenjdk.jitwatch.model.assembly. I found no concrete evidence that this package depends on packages less stable than itself.
